result.instructions: Tools for Gelato, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Gelato data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run gelato_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gelato_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gelato_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. gelato_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gelato_list_catalogs
tools.title: List product catalogs
tools.description: List Gelato's product catalogs (posters, cards, t-shirts, mugs, photo books, ...) with their catalogUid and title. Start here to find products. GET product.gelatoapis.com/v3/catalogs.

tools.name: gelato_get_catalog
tools.title: Get catalog
tools.description: One catalog with the attributes that define its products (e.g. PaperFormat, PaperType, ColorType) and each attribute's possible values. Use them as attribute_filters in gelato_search_products. GET /v3/catalogs/{catalogUid}.

tools.name: gelato_search_products
tools.title: Search catalog products
tools.description: List the products of a catalog, optionally filtered by attribute values, with each product's productUid, attributes, weight and dimensions, plus hit counts per attribute value. POST /v3/catalogs/{catalogUid}/products:search.

attribute_filters.description: Attribute name → accepted values, e.g. {"Orientation":["hor"],"PaperFormat":["A4","A3"]} (names and values from gelato_get_catalog).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: gelato_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One catalog product by productUid: attributes, weight, supported and unsupported countries, whether it is printable or stockable, and valid page counts for multi-page products. GET /v3/products/{productUid}.

tools.name: gelato_get_product_prices
tools.title: Get product prices
tools.description: Gelato's production prices of a product for every quantity tier, optionally for one destination country and currency. page_count is required for multi-page products. Shipping is not included (use gelato_quote_order). GET /v3/products/{productUid}/prices.

country.description: 2-letter ISO 3166-1 country code (the United Kingdom is GB, not UK).

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or EUR.

page_count.description: Page count, required for multi-page products.

tools.name: gelato_get_cover_dimensions
tools.title: Get cover dimensions
tools.description: Cover layout of a multi-page product (photo book, brochure) in millimetres: spine, front, back, bleed and wraparound areas, for designing the cover file. GET /v3/products/{productUid}/cover-dimensions.

product_uid.description: Gelato product UID of a multi-page product.

page_count.description: Total page count including covers (see validPageCounts in gelato_get_product).

tools.name: gelato_check_stock
tools.title: Check stock availability
tools.description: Stock status of stockable products per stock region (US-CA, EU, UK, OC, AS, SA, ROW): in-stock, out-of-stock-replenishable (with a replenishment date), out-of-stock, non-stockable or not-supported. POST /v3/stock/region-availability.

tools.name: gelato_list_shipment_methods
tools.title: List shipment methods
tools.description: Gelato's shipment methods (shipmentMethodUid, name, type normal/express/pallet, tracking, business/private, supported destination countries), optionally only those for one destination country. GET shipment.gelatoapis.com/v1/shipment-methods.

country.description: Only methods that deliver to this 2-letter ISO country code.

tools.name: gelato_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search orders and drafts, newest first: id, your reference ids, order type, fulfillment and financial status, channel, store, country, currency, totals and dates. Filter by status, type, country, channel, store, reference, date range or free text (recipient name or order reference). POST /v4/orders:search.

search.description: Free text matched against the recipient's first or last name and orderReferenceId.

countries.description: Only orders shipping to these countries (2-letter ISO codes).

items.description: 2-letter ISO 3166-1 country code (the United Kingdom is GB, not UK).
3-letter ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or EUR.

channels.description: Only orders from these channels (ui, api, shopify, etsy).

store_ids.description: Only orders from these e-commerce store ids.

start_date.description: Only orders ordered or created on or after this ISO 8601 date-time (e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

end_date.description: Only orders ordered or created on or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: gelato_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by Gelato order id: type (order/draft), fulfillment and financial status, items with their files and statuses, shipment with packages and tracking codes/URLs, shipping address, receipts and totals. GET /v4/orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: gelato_quote_order
tools.title: Quote order
tools.description: Price an order before placing it: product prices and the available shipment methods (shipmentMethodUid, price, min/max delivery days and dates) per fulfillment facility, for a recipient address. Nothing is created or charged. Pass a returned shipmentMethodUid to gelato_create_order. POST /v4/orders:quote.

order_reference_id.description: Your order reference id for the quote.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or EUR.

post_code.description: Postal code (required where the country uses them).

state.description: State/province code, required for US, CA and AU (e.g. NY).

country.description: 2-letter ISO 3166-1 country code (the United Kingdom is GB, not UK).

email.description: Recipient email (required by Gelato; used for delivery notifications).

is_business.description: Brazil only: true if the recipient is a company (then state_tax_id and registration_state_code apply).

federal_tax_id.description: Brazil only, required there: CPF (person) or CNPJ (company).

state_tax_id.description: Brazil only: the company's state tax id (Inscrição Estadual).

registration_state_code.description: Brazil only: the state code where the company is registered.

recipient.description: Delivery address the quote is for.

item_reference_id.description: Your id for this line, unique within the order.

product_uid.description: Gelato product UID (from gelato_search_products or a store product variant).

files.description: Print files (required for printable products only).

type.description: Print area: "default" (the primary area, e.g. the front of apparel), "front", "back", or an embroidery position. Default "default".

url.description: Public URL Gelato downloads the file from (PDF, PNG, TIFF, SVG or JPEG).

page_count.description: Page count, multi-page products only (covers included).

allow_multiple_quotes.description: Default true: one quote per fulfillment facility when one facility cannot make everything. False: one combined quote.

tools.name: gelato_create_order
tools.title: Create order (draft by default)
tools.description: Create an order. By default it is a DRAFT: nothing is produced or charged until it is submitted with gelato_submit_draft_order (or in the dashboard). With order_type "order" Gelato starts production and charges the account right away. Shipment: a shipmentMethodUid from gelato_quote_order, or "normal"/"standard"/"express"; omitted = the cheapest. POST /v4/orders.

order_type.description: "draft" (default; review first) or "order" (produced and charged immediately).

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or EUR.

item_reference_id.description: Your id for this line, unique within the order.

product_uid.description: Gelato product UID (from gelato_search_products or a store product variant).

files.description: Print files (required for printable products only).

type.description: Print area: "default" (the primary area, e.g. the front of apparel), "front", "back", or an embroidery position. Default "default".

url.description: Public URL Gelato downloads the file from (PDF, PNG, TIFF, SVG or JPEG).

page_count.description: Page count, multi-page products only (covers included).

post_code.description: Postal code (required where the country uses them).

state.description: State/province code, required for US, CA and AU (e.g. NY).

country.description: 2-letter ISO 3166-1 country code (the United Kingdom is GB, not UK).

email.description: Recipient email (required by Gelato; used for delivery notifications).

is_business.description: Brazil only: true if the recipient is a company (then state_tax_id and registration_state_code apply).

federal_tax_id.description: Brazil only, required there: CPF (person) or CNPJ (company).

state_tax_id.description: Brazil only: the company's state tax id (Inscrição Estadual).

registration_state_code.description: Brazil only: the state code where the company is registered.

shipment_method_uid.description: A shipmentMethodUid from gelato_quote_order, or "normal", "standard", "express". Several values may be given separated by commas (no spaces). Omitted = cheapest.

metadata.description: Up to 20 key/value pairs stored on the order.

tools.name: gelato_submit_draft_order
tools.title: Submit draft order
tools.description: Convert a DRAFT order into a regular order: Gelato starts production and charges the account. Items stay as they are. Only drafts can be submitted. PATCH /v4/orders/{orderId} {"orderType":"order"}.

order_id.description: Gelato order id of a draft order.

tools.name: gelato_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel order
tools.description: Cancel an order before production. Gelato refuses (HTTP 409) once any item is printed or the order has shipped. This cannot be undone. POST /v4/orders/{orderId}:cancel.

tools.name: gelato_delete_draft_order
tools.title: Delete draft order
tools.description: Permanently delete a DRAFT order (regular orders cannot be deleted; cancel them instead). DELETE /v4/orders/{orderId}.

order_id.description: Gelato order id of a draft order.

tools.name: gelato_list_store_products
tools.title: List store products
tools.description: Products of a connected e-commerce store (Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce, ...) as Gelato knows them: id, title, status (created/publishing/publishing_error/active), external id, variants with their productUid, preview images and dates. The store id is in the Gelato dashboard URL of the store and on its orders (storeId). GET ecommerce.gelatoapis.com/v1/stores/{storeId}/products.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: gelato_get_store_product
tools.title: Get store product
tools.description: One product of a connected store: title, description, status, variants (with productUid and external ids), options, preview and publishing state. GET /v1/stores/{storeId}/products/{productId}.

tools.name: gelato_get_template
tools.title: Get template
tools.description: A product template made in the Gelato dashboard: title, description, preview, and its variants (id, title, productUid; pass the variant id as template_variant_id) with their image placeholders (names to fill in gelato_create_product_from_template). GET /v1/templates/{templateId}.

template_id.description: Template id (Gelato dashboard → the template's URL).

tools.name: gelato_create_product_from_template
tools.title: Create store product from template
tools.description: Create a product in a connected store from a template, with your own images in the template's placeholders. Gelato creates the product, then publishes variants and mockups in the background (track it with gelato_get_store_product). Hidden in the online store unless visible_in_online_store is true. POST /v1/stores/{storeId}/products:create-from-template.

description.description: Product description (HTML allowed by most stores).

visible_in_online_store.description: Show the product in the online store (default false).

sales_channels.description: Sales channels: "web" (default) or "global" (Shopify Point of Sale).

tags.description: Product tags, at most 13 (Etsy stores: 20 characters each).

product_type.description: Product type shown in the store.

variants.description: Variants to create (omit for all template variants), each with the images for its placeholders.

file_url.description: Public image URL (jpg, jpeg, png or pdf).

fit_method.description: "slice" (default: fill and crop) or "meet" (fit the whole image).
